newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda recalls 1,560 Lancia cars in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Mazda recalls 1,560 Lancia cars in Japan.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp said on Thursday it had told the Transport Ministry that it is recalling 1,560 Lancia Thema sedans made by Fiat Auto SpA to repair a fault that could cause accelerator problems.
The defective models were imported between November 28, 1989 and November 1, 1994.
The fault lies in a plastic component and could lead to problems with engine revolution.
Mazda, owned 33.4 percent by Ford Motor Co, imports and sells Lancia and Citroen cars in Japan.
No accidents have been reported but the company has received three complaints in Japan, a Mazda spokesman said.
